## Change / 改动

Explain the user-visible problem and why this is the smallest useful fix.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Added a regression test using synthetic data.
- [ ] Core tests pass, or explain why they were not run.
- [ ] For Android changes: both flavor unit tests, lint and Debug assembly pass.
- [ ] State any real-device/provider checks not performed.
- [ ] No private conversations, databases, credentials or signing material included.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior; no unmeasured quality/token claims.

## Compatibility and privacy / 兼容性与隐私

Describe schema/configuration changes, provenance/deletion impact and added costs.
MIT has been selected; the copyright-holder placeholder still needs finalization.
Discuss substantial third-party code additions and their licenses with the maintainer.
